title: RANKX treats a BLANK value as 0: ascending, it ranks after the negative numbers
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( Nums, "r", RANKX ( Nums, Nums[N], , ASC ) )

source.quote: If expression or value evaluates to BLANK it is treated as a 0 (zero) for all expressions that result in a number
source.supports: in RANKX a BLANK ranks as the number 0

derivation: Nums[N] by Id: -5 (1), BLANK (2), 3 (3), -1 (4), 10 (5). With BLANK as 0 the values are -5, 0, 3, -1, 10. Ascending ranks: -5 is 1, -1 is 2, 0 (the BLANK) is 3, 3 is 4, 10 is 5. No ties.
notes: Contrast with assumptions/order-by-asc-blank-before-negative, where ORDER BY is expected to put BLANK before -5. If RANKX ranked BLANK lowest, row 2 would rank 1 and rows 1 and 4 would rank 2 and 3.
